context_and_flow.screen_type: Onboarding or profile setup screen for a skincare application.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: Capture user age range data to provide personalized skincare recommendations.
ux_patterns: The mascot is a simple, minimalist line-art character that adds a friendly, approachable touch.
The layout uses high contrast with large, distinct white selection cards on a soft gradient background.
The design uses a standard iOS status bar header.
The layout is vertically centered for better readability and thumb reachability.
